Metro V2.0.title: Australia Post Metro Service Integration Specification

rules.title: Metro (M2M) header branding
rules.description: Metro labels use the simplified Metro template and carry the M2M mark beside the Australia Post hero brand.

messages.fail: The header doesn't show a Metro label: {actual}. Check the M2M mark on the label.
messages.missing: No M2M mark was read. Check the Metro branding on the label.

rules.title: Routing details line (country, state, postcode)
rules.description: Metro labels carry a routing block holding the destination country code (AU for domestic), destination state and postcode. All three must be uppercase and on one line.
rules.expectedText: AU, the state and the postcode, e.g. AU VIC 3000

messages.pass: Routing details line is present and correctly formatted: {actual}.
messages.fail: Routing details line is not formatted as uppercase AU, state and postcode: {actual}.
messages.missing: No routing line (AU, state, postcode) was read. Check it's printed, in capitals and centred.

rules.title: Routing postcode matches the delivery address
rules.description: The postcode in the routing block must equal the delivery postcode shown in the TO address block.

messages.pass: Routing postcode {actual} matches the delivery address postcode.
messages.fail: Routing postcode {actual} doesn't match the delivery address postcode. Check it on the label, as text reading can misread it.

rules.title: Routing state matches the delivery address
rules.description: The routing block's state must match the state in the delivery address.

messages.pass: Routing state {actual} matches the delivery address state.
messages.fail: Routing state {actual} doesn't match the delivery address state. Check it on the label, as text reading can misread it.

rules.title: Delivery is inside the Metro area
rules.description: Metro only delivers to listed localities in Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth and Sydney. The list lives in metro-localities.json.

rules.title: Sender and delivery in the same Metro city
rules.description: Metro parcels are picked up and delivered in the same city, for example Melbourne to Melbourne.

rules.title: Consignment number printed
rules.description: The consignment number assigned when the shipment was created is a mandatory Metro label field. Its agreement with the decoded barcode is checked separately by EP-ART-07.

messages.pass: A consignment number is printed on the label.
messages.fail: No consignment number was read. Check the Consignment No field is printed.

rules.title: Article count (n of N) printed
rules.description: The total number of articles in the consignment must be displayed, e.g. 1 of 1 for a single-article consignment.

messages.pass: Article count is printed on the label: {actual}.
messages.fail: Article count text is not in the expected n of N form: {actual}.
messages.missing: No article count (n of N) was read. Check the Article n of N field is printed.
